title: bidens bidentoides
intro: Bidens bidentoides, commonly known as "Tickseed Coreopsis," is a flowering plant native to North America, belonging to the daisy family (Asteraceae). The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as fever, wounds, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Bidens bidentoides are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit antimicrobial and anti-cancer properties. Research on the plant's bioactive constituents is ongoing, but existing studies suggest that it may have applications in wound healing, anti-inflammatory treatments, and potential anti-cancer therapies.
